ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixel distribution across ~85% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white/light grey) highlights and markings constituting the remaining ~15% contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-intensity regions across central and leading fluke surfaces. Discrete, high-intensity punctate spots and irregular mottling are concentrated along the trailing edges and at the lateral tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central notch with an estimated pixel angle of 115-120 degrees at the base of the depression dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary along the entire trailing edge; serration amplitude increases significantly towards the lateral tips, showing jagged peaks of approximately 15-25 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the central notch towards the lateral tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-intensity pixel clusters (diameters <10 pixels) distributed across the ventral surface, with the highest density observed on the right lobe and at the lateral margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, light-grey linear pixel disruptions of varying lengths (10-50 pixels) and unaligned orientations visible on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and jagged profile at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; heavy white encrustation visible at the terminal ends.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced cluster of high-intensity white material (likely barnacle colonization) at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
